name: session-kit
description: Hooks and a handoff skill that every project can use: context-pressure warnings, git and test-run guards, prose-tells warnings, formatting with the project's own tools, a test-run log, a direnv environment, a root pyrightconfig.json for multi-package repositories, the checkout checks (a missing or stale handoff, uncommitted work at the end of a turn), the suppression warning with its ledger check, the session-tells, session-codeintel, session-intent (with its id allocator), session-transcripts, session-suppressions, session-rulebook and session-docs commands, and a looks check and a layers pack in session-codeintel, and CLAUDE.local.md handoffs.

thresholdTokens.title: Context warning from
thresholdTokens.description: Tokens of context past which the model is warned to find a clear point, firmer at one and a half times and at twice that; 0 turns the count off.

threshold.title: Context warning percent
threshold.description: The alternative: percent of the context window past which the model is warned; 0 (the default) leaves it to the token count, and with both set the first reached warns.

step.title: Context warning step
step.description: Tokens the context has to grow past the last warning before it is warned again.

chain.title: Handoff chain
chain.description: The clear_point tool, after which the handoff, the compaction and the continue run when the turn ends, or stop when the next step is the owner's; and the new_task tool, after which the band offers the handoff and a clear, or to keep going here, and sends the prompt again.

docLines.title: Document length cap
docLines.description: Lines past which a markdown file under docs/ is named to the model after an edit, to be split.
